summary: Grand piano: full, clear, ballads, pop, jazz, gospel
label: grand piano
body: Chords in the middle (MIDI 48-72), bass notes in the left hand only if there's no bass part. House piano: stabs on the off-beats. Warmer and closer: sound/keys-upright-piano.

Register: MIDI 36-96 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Grand Piano, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Grand Piano") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
